adsHelpDesc:
You can create ads to showcase various products or services you offer on MogeHub, such as motorcycles, helmets, apparel, repair services, and more. Choose the most relevant category so your ad is easier for potential buyers to find.

Each ad will display complete information including description, price, images, and contact details. Potential buyers will contact you directly through the WhatsApp number you provide, allowing communication and transactions to happen directly.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy explains how the operator of the MogeHub platform collects, uses, stores, processes, protects, and shares users' personal data.
By using MogeHub, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to this Privacy Policy.
MogeHub is a large motorcycle (moge) community platform providing forum features and advertising services as its core feature.

sections.title: 2. Platform Scope
paragraphs: MogeHub provides a community forum for users to create threads, share experiences, ask questions, and interact using text, links, image links, and embedded YouTube videos.
MogeHub also provides advertising features for users to promote products, services, promotions, and banners.

sections.title: 3. Data We Collect
paragraphs: User identity data such as name, username, email address, and profile information.
User activity data including forum posts, comments, interactions, and feature usage.
User-generated content including text, links, images, embedded videos, and advertising materials.
Transaction data related to advertising package purchases.
Technical data such as IP address, device information, browser type, operating system, logs, cookies, and similar technologies.

sections.title: 4. How We Collect Data
paragraphs: Data is collected directly from users during registration, profile completion, content creation, advertising submission, and platform usage.
Data may also be collected automatically through system logs, cookies, and similar technologies.

sections.title: 5. Purpose of Data Usage
paragraphs: To operate, manage, maintain, and improve the MogeHub platform.
To display and manage forum content and advertisements.
To process advertising package transactions through third-party services.
To maintain security, prevent abuse, fraud, and policy violations.
To communicate important information related to the platform.

sections.title: 6. Legal Basis for Processing
paragraphs: Data is processed based on user consent, contractual necessity, legal obligations, and the legitimate interests of MogeHub.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
paragraphs: User data is retained as long as the account remains active or as required for operational purposes.
Certain data may be retained longer if required by applicable laws.

sections.title: 8. Data Security
paragraphs: MogeHub implements reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect user data.
However, no electronic system can be guaranteed to be fully secure.

sections.title: 9. Data Sharing with Third Parties
paragraphs: MogeHub may share data with third-party service providers such as payment gateways, hosting providers, and infrastructure partners.
MogeHub does not sell personal data to any third party.
Data is shared only as necessary for operational purposes.

sections.title: 10. Payment Gateway and Third Parties
paragraphs: Advertising package transactions are processed through third-party payment service providers.
MogeHub is not a financial service provider.
The privacy policies of such providers apply to their respective data processing.

sections.title: 11. User-Generated Content
paragraphs: All user-generated content remains the sole responsibility of the user.
MogeHub only acts as a platform provider and does not guarantee the accuracy or legality of user content.
MogeHub may store, display, and process user content as necessary to operate the service.

sections.title: 12. User Rights
paragraphs: Users have the right to access and update their personal data through their account.
Users may request account deletion in accordance with platform policies and applicable laws.
Certain requests may be denied where legally required.

sections.title: 13. Minimum Age
paragraphs: MogeHub is intended only for users who are at least 17 years old.
By using the platform, users confirm that they meet the minimum age requirement.

sections.title: 14. Data Storage and Transfer
paragraphs: User data may be stored and processed on servers located inside or outside Indonesia in accordance with applicable regulations.

sections.title: 15. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: MogeHub may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
Updates will be announced through the platform and become effective immediately.

sections.title: 16. Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: support@mogehub.com

sections.title: 17. Governing Law
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.

bannerHelpSubtitle: How Banner Ads work in MogeHub
bannerHelpDesc:
Banner Ads is a promotional feature that allows you to display promo ads, events, or services on the MogeHub homepage.

You can also use this banner for:
- Product or service promotion
- Special events / campaigns
- Discounts or limited-time offers

When creating a banner, you can set:
• A category that matches your promo type
• A subcategory that corresponds to the category you selected earlier
• The banner title you want to promote
• A complete description of the banner information to be displayed
• The start and end date of the promotion
• The city where your promo, event, or service is taking place
• A destination link if you want users to see more details about your promo or event (website / marketplace / WhatsApp / product details)

Make sure to upload the banner with the recommended size.

description_paragraphs: When you first register or join MogeHub, you will automatically receive a Basic plan for FREE permanently.
With the Basic plan, you can create 1 product ad and 1 banner ad. You can post more ads by upgrading to a subscription plan. The ad quota depends on the package details.
The higher the plan you choose, the more ads you can post on MogeHub. With paid plans, your ads will also appear instantly after being created.
If your paid plan expires and is not renewed, your account will automatically revert to the Basic plan without losing any account data. You can upgrade again at any time.
